title: Two-level mall corridor with food stands selling ridiculously expensive muffins

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have had similar experiences, specifically items priced in real-life currency

position.relative_to: above the first/main floor corridor with food stands

qualities.raw_description: “very cozy… dimly lit with soft seats and kinda cramped but not to the point where it feels claustrophobic.” Drinks: “If you want to get any of the more elaborate drinks you have to be there before a certain time or that section of the café closes… more basic (but still very good) drinks.”

locations.location_name: First/main floor wide corridor with food stands

qualities.raw_description: “very lively with tons of people walking past or browsing different food stands… rather wide corridor with both sides full of food/baked goods vendors.” “In the middle are two kitchen-isle like tables with muffins piled high and low.”

locations.location_name: Off-limits lighthouse (top area where café seems to exist)

position.relative_to: café seems to exist at the top of this lighthouse

qualities.raw_description: “The second floor café also seems to exist at the top of an off-limits lighthouse… sometimes there’s someone trying to enforce the whole off-limits part.”

connections.qualities: Two-level structure implied: dreamer visits second-floor café; first/main floor corridor below.
“very narrow stairs leading up” to the café at the top of an off-limits lighthouse; dreamer has “entered that way too before.”

boundaries.description: Area described as “off-limits”; “sometimes there’s someone trying to enforce the whole off-limits part,” but dreamer has entered via the lighthouse stairs before.

interactions.description: Dreamer buys “hot tea or similar to go” at the upstairs café; dreamer is often “having to go somewhere.”
To get “more elaborate drinks” the dreamer must arrive “before a certain time” or “that section of the café closes,” leaving only “more basic (but still very good) drinks.”
Dreamer tries to buy muffins from the central tables; prices read as “one muffin was 70$ and the second one ‘only’ 50$,” and the dreamer declines (“No thank you”). The price startles them awake.
interactions.transaction_blocker: price: $70 for one muffin; $50 for the second

interactions.description: Dreamer enters via the off-limits lighthouse route; sometimes someone attempts to enforce the off-limits restriction.

entities_involved.description: “someone trying to enforce the whole off-limits part”

extraction.extraction_notes: No explicit description of the connector between first/main floor and second-floor café (stairs/elevator not specified). Café’s “part-closing time” is a temporal rule but no clock time given. First floor described as not previously visited until “tonight.”
